notes.title: Hello Girl's first merch is here~
notes.content:
Hello Girl's first bit of merch is now up for pre-order!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45409419/43b8439e1983c40d80334560b3d778459bf1b0ee.png"]

Hello Girl-related merch has been requested for some time, and finally I've come up with something!

An embroidered keychain featuring Yuno can be yours~

These come with a postcard signed by the main members of IMO Team!

(Stock is limited to 50)



Order here!



Pre-orders have no pre-defined end date and will instead end when I receive the product in-hand and begin to start shipping. After which I will sell them as normal until stock runs out. Details like size and shipping costs can be seen at the store listing link above.



Thanks for supporting us and for leaving so many nice reviews ^^

We hope to have some news about the sequel later this year!



-Mentha
